title: Purdue, Deloitte to discuss how technology is reshaping careers
summary_en: The "Deloitte x Purdue: New Careers at the Edge of Engineering and National Leadership" event will take place from 5-6 p.m. Monday, Sept. 14, at Stewart Center's Loeb Playhouse.
